add     -> funcoes linkadas sem $DOC$ em lugar nenhum
patch   -> por argumento, so o que muda; NUNCA edite os .txt de hbdoc/

IIF.one: Return one of two values depending on a logical condition

STOD.one: Convert a date string in yyyymmdd format to a date value

DBRELATION.one: Return the linking expression of a specified relation

DBRSELECT.one: Return the target work area number of a relation

DIRECTORY.one: Create an array of directory and file information

MEMOLINE.one: Extract a line of text from a character string or memo field

MLCOUNT.one: Count the number of lines in a character string or memo field

ORDDESCEND.one: Return and optionally change the descending flag of an order

ORDISUNIQUE.one: Return the status of the unique flag for a given order

ORDKEYCOUNT.one: Return the number of keys in an order

ORDKEYNO.one: Return the logical record number of the current key in an order

ORDKEYVAL.one: Return the key value of the current record from the controlling order

ORDNAME.one: Return the name of an order in the order list

ORDNUMBER.one: Return the position of an order in the order list

RDDNAME.one: Return the name of the RDD active in the current work area

SOUNDEX.one: Convert a character string to a sound-alike code

STUFF.one: Delete and insert characters in a string

RECNO._: a doc diz `--> Identity`, fora da notacao; num DBF e sempre numero

MEMOTRAN._: Clipper 5.3: MEMOTRAN(<cString>, [<cHard>], [<cSoft>]); confirmado no binario com MemoTran("a")

ORDKEY._: sem argumento = ordem controladora; confirmado com OrdKey()

patch._cat: categoria e para NAVEGAR, nao para tipar: Val/Str/CToD sao conversoes ainda que a doc as ponha em Strings
